app.title: Lanterns
welcome.slide1.title: Screen for Diabetic Retinopathy
welcome.slide1.body: Capture a retinal image and get an AI-assisted severity grade in seconds, right at the point of care.
welcome.slide2.title: Works fully offline
welcome.slide2.body: No internet connection needed after first install. Every model, every screen, every report generates entirely on this device — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
welcome.slide3.title: Built for the field
welcome.slide3.body: Patient intake, capture, AI grading, PDF report, and ophthalmologist review — one continuous workflow for rural and district-level screening.
